title: Injected downstream air leak on a summer day (the dev twin of the core leak)
notes: The dev twin of the core-10 inject_air_leak_downstream, added with the consistent leak injection on 2026-09-23: the same injection at the same 02:00 of the data clock for its default 240 minutes, with the same expectation, replayed on the summer day of summer_normal_jul05 instead of 3 February, so the leak can be designed and verified without reading the test split. It is on the tuning list and in no profile but dev, so the core and full runs behind E3, E4 and E6 never replay it. The change was made after the E3 and E4 results had been seen, and argued from physics, so the core scenario's later figures stay in-sample.
